title: cwc-championship-1998-world-heavyweight-championship
label: Leviathan

won.source: The fed's own broadcast commentary repeatedly bills Leviathan as champion "ever since... he won the title at First Night," the fed's own pay-per-view held after the held record's quarterfinal broadcast (26 May 1998) and before its own 28 June 1998 house show, where Leviathan is already champion. No document in the held record covers First Night itself or names a runner-up; the reign is recorded from the fed's own repeated billing rather than a witnessed result.

note: Retained the title at Prime Time in North America (21 July 1998) after Superstars, Incorporated sent out Jude St. Claire disguised as Leviathan to lose the belt in a sham match; the real Leviathan, freed from being tied up backstage, then beat Johnny Detson for real.

title: cwc-championship-1998-international-peoples-championship
label: Jose Garces

won.source: The fed's own broadcast commentary states Jose Garces "went on to win the belt back in early June" after a tournament that began at the fed's own First Night pay-per-view; no document in the held record covers the title change itself, so the reign is recorded from the fed's own repeated billing rather than a witnessed result.

note: Retained the title at Prime Time in North America (21 July 1998) when challenger Jude St. Claire won by disqualification after masked interference from Mike Sebastian; a title cannot change hands on a disqualification finish.

title: cwc-championship-1998-north-american-heavyweight-championship
label: Paul Kingstead

won.source: Prime Time in North America, 21 July 1998.

how: Last man standing in the inaugural four-way elimination match, pinning Lord Keeblor with a tilt-a-whirl backbreaker into a tight package after Frank Claiborne was counted out and Nekrataal was pinned.

title: cwc-championship-1998-world-tag-team-championship
label: L.A. Wrecking Crew

won.source: Prime Time in North America, 21 July 1998.

how: Eclipse pinned Earl "The Hammer" Mandigault after Superstars, Incorporated's attempt to steal the belts was foiled by Latin Lightning and the Baby Face Brawler.
